entities.name: Hadži-Prodan Gligorijević
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Prodan Gligorijević, known as Hadži-Prodan (Хаџи-Продан), was a Serbian revolutionary commander (vojvoda) in the First Serbian Uprising of the Serbian Revolution, then the Greek War of Independence, against the Ottoman Empire. He led an unsuccessful rebellion in 1814, dubbed Hadži-Prodan's rebellion.

entities.summary: Prodan Gligorijević, known as Hadži-Prodan (Хаџи-Продан), was a Serbian revolutionary commander (vojvoda) in the First Serbian Uprising of the Serbian Revolution, then the Greek War of Independence, against the Ottoman Empire. He led an unsuccessful rebellion in 1814, dubbed Hadži-Prodan's rebellion.
